## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — see CONTRIBUTING.md (DCO)
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (tests · checks · safety · busted)
- [ ] Tested on a running server — build/framework: <!-- e.g. b3258 · Qbox / standalone -->
- [ ] Capabilities: **unchanged** / **changed** — if changed, say why each new capability is needed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md of the touched package updated (`## Unreleased`)
- [ ] No binaries, minified/bundled JS, or streamed GTA assets added
